description: This file extends the Summernote rich text editor's Hebrew (Israel) localization by adding translated strings for various UI components such as font styles, image handling, videos, links, tables, styles, lists, options, paragraphs, colors, shortcuts, help, history, and special characters.

methods.name: Immediately Invoked Function Expression (IIFE)
methods.description: Initializes the localization extension for Summernote by extending its language settings with Hebrew (Israel) translations.
